scope.implemented_contract: nonlinear stationary Hartree and restricted unpolarized pure-LDA Kohn-Sham states assembled from the accepted exact-Wilson one-electron, RI-Wilson Hartree, and Wilson-LDA actions
scope.fixtures: H2 and equilateral H3+ in STO-3G with the lda,vwn functional, unpruned PySCF molecular grids, exact affine straight-Wilson phases, and static uniform magnetic fields
included: direct generalized Hermitian stationary solve in the Wilson metric without Löwdin or Cholesky propagation coordinates
self-consistent Hartree and Kohn-Sham branches with one fixed closed-shell occupation
orbital, density fixed-point, mixed-index commutator, metric orthonormality, particle-number, occupation-spectrum, and density-factorization identities
field-free comparison to independent PySCF RHF and RKS references
electromagnetic gauge covariance of energy, density, coefficients, and lower matrices
stationarity finite differences, SCF-tolerance refinement, and molecular-grid refinement
exact-minus-P0 one-electron diagnostics evaluated on exact stationary states
CPU and physical-GPU regression coverage of the accepted action stack

effect: NQ4 accepted and NQ5 source-derivative and static-observable qualification authorized
limitations: the accepted nonlinear Kohn-Sham closure remains restricted, spin unpolarized, and pure LDA
the accepted stationary campaign is bounded to fixed nuclei, finite molecular Gaussian bases, uniform static magnetic fields, and the dipole approximation
exact-minus-P0 values are one-electron diagnostics on exact stationary states, not self-consistent reduced-model results
time-dependent propagation, source derivatives of the complete nonlinear action, Ward identities, continuity, and finite-region balance are not accepted by this decision
the first incomplete campaign root, the completed root with incorrect traceability labels, and the documented first analysis pass remain superseded evidence
raw_artifact_policy: Raw campaign artifacts and all documented superseded roots and analysis passes remain immutable; this separate review record carries the acceptance decision.
